_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Iraga Player {player_id} ring Tic Tac Toe Tiga Pemain.
Simbol Iragane '{symbol}'.
Iraga ngambil giliran nyimpen simbol Iragane ring papan 5x5 anggén ngwangun garis empat.
Garisé dados horizontal, vertikal, utawi diagonal.
Kirim tetanduran Iragane nganggén format '[4]' anggén ngenahin sel 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format pindah nénten valid. Anggén "[cell]" ring genah selnyané 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomor sel tan sah: {cell}. Patut dados ring tengah 0 miwah {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Pamain {player_id} ngalaksanayang pamargi sané nénten patut.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} ngwangun simbol ipun ({symbol}) ring lapangan ({row}, {col}).
